intent: Prove that a planted purpose-bound secret (email fetched for send_calendar_invite, leaked into an unrelated general_summary) is CAUGHT by the deterministic gate before the response ships, that a benign in-purpose use PASSES, and that the gate's own output never re-leaks the secret.
riskRationale: The artifact is a security boundary (a privacy gate). A weak gate that produces confident receipts is worse than no gate, so this is graded as high risk per MY_REPO_SHAPE.

constraints.detail: gate() returns verdict 'leak' with one purpose_mismatch violation on getContact.email.
Same email used IN the send_calendar_invite tool call yields verdict 'pass', zero violations.

JSON.stringify(verdict) contains neither the raw email nor the fragment 'alice.planted', and NO value-derived token (no fingerprint/hash). Verdict is structural-only -> provably non-reversible (R2 fix).
Disabling the purpose-mismatch branch in gate.ts turns the planted-leak tests RED; restoring it returns 16/16 GREEN.
50 repeated gate() calls over the same input produce byte-identical serialized verdicts.

observations.detail: getContact returned field 'email' under declaredPurpose 'send_calendar_invite'; classified as email_address and tracked.
user_message sink with purpose 'general_summary' contains the tracked email.

actions.result: planted-leak tests go RED — confirms the purpose-mismatch check is load-bearing

assertions.detail: raw value absent; no fingerprint/hash field present; verdict is structural-only

evidence.note: Real gate() output, redaction-safe (no raw secret).

mechanisms: A deterministic, cheap pre-ship privacy referee that any tool-using agent can call instead of (or before) a non-deterministic LLM judge.
Receipts emitted in proof-spec + goodput shape so other notebooks (gateproof, mergegate, My AX) can consume them directly.
projection.notes: Context only. Not a score. The gate is proven on hand-built GateInput fixtures, NOT yet on a real agent wire (see status.json unproven[]).
